title: Sociale herkomst van studenten aan de Universiteit van Amsterdam, 1965-1985
authors: Vink, A.M.E., Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Sociologisch instituut (primary investigator)
descriptions: Social background of male and female students at the University of Amsterdam and the ( supposed ) relation between social background and field of study, previous training and age at which study is started. Occupational level of father / field of study / previous training / age at which study is started. Background variables: basic characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education
